checks.claim: M7: the IEM daily values are whole degrees F
M7: the freeze-thaw gap (67 vs 73) is most likely from rounding the temperatures
checks.detail: Rounding moves a value by at most 0.5 F, so two whole-degree readings of one temperature differ by at most 1 F. The daily maximum differs by more than 1 F on 131 days, and the minimum on 127 days (mean GHCN minus IEM: +0.74 F for maxima, -0.74 F for minima). The largest gap is 23.96 F on 2025-10-26 (IEM minimum 12.0 F, between IEM 48 F on 10-25 and 33 F on 10-27; GHCN 35.96 F). Two of the eight classification flips are beyond rounding: 2025-01-24 (GHCN maximum 33.08 F, IEM 32.0) and 2025-03-10 (GHCN minimum 30.2 F, IEM 32.0). The sources disagree on specific days.
